calls.statement:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT x.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.join_date, m.valid_from mv, m.valid_to mt
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure x LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = x.member_key
  WHERE x.campaign_id = 19
), h AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 19)
SELECT
  count(*) rows_,
  count(DISTINCT exposure_id) dist_exposure,
  count(DISTINCT member_key) dist_key,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) dist_member,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN delivered THEN member_id END) dist_delivered,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM h) THEN member_id END) in_holdout,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN member_id IS NULL THEN member_key END) orphan_keys,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN marketing_consent = false THEN member_id END) no_consent,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM h) holdout_rows,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM h) holdout_dist,
  min(contact_ts_utc), max(contact_ts_utc),
  count(DISTINCT contact_channel) chans
FROM e

SELECT
  count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_line,
  count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl,
  sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff,
  sum(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nomember,
  sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_mismatch_hel,
  sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_mismatch_utc,
  min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at),
  sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross,
  sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN net_amount END) webnet,
  sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negs
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = x.member_key
  WHERE x.campaign_id = 19
), s AS (
  SELECT f.*, m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted)
), r AS (
  SELECT rt.*, m.member_id FROM fact_return_line rt JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = rt.member_key
  WHERE rt.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted)
)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) contacted,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM s) buyers,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s) net_all,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) net_nostaff,
 (SELECT sum(gross_amount) FROM s) gross_all,
 (SELECT sum(gross_amount) FROM s WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) gross_nostaff,
 (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM r) ret_net_by_returndate,
 (SELECT sum(refund_gross) FROM r) ret_gross,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM s WHERE channel_code='WB') web_lines,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT channel_code) FROM s) chcodes,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s WHERE channel_code IS NULL) nullch

WITH f AS (
 SELECT sum(f.net_amount) all_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) nostaff_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN f.net_amount END) physical_net, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) phys_nostaff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'),
r AS (SELECT sum(returns_net) rn, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nb, sum(net_sales) ns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'),
rr AS (SELECT sum(refund_net) all_ret, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN refund_net END) phys_ret FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')
SELECT * FROM f, r, rr

WITH ck AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_key FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=19),
cid AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM ck JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key)),
dl AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE campaign_id=19 AND delivered),
w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ck) naive_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cid) members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dl) delivered_members,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM w WHERE member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM ck)) naive_key_spend,
 (SELECT sum(w.net_amount) FROM w JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM cid)) member_spend,
 (SELECT sum(w.net_amount) FROM w JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dl)) delivered_spend,
 (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM cid)) refunds,
 (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND s.sale_date<DATE '2026-05-04' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM cid)) refunds_of_earlier_sales

calls.statement:
WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_campaign c ON c.campaign_id = x.campaign_id
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = x.member_key
  WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Spring Garden Launch 2026'
), sales AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS net_sales_before_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted)
), refunds AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = r.member_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted)
)
SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) AS members_contacted,
  sales.net_sales_before_returns - refunds.refunds_net AS net_spend_eur
FROM sales, refunds
